name: adc-sandbox-usage
description: How to use the ADC zone runtime-domain connector correctly. It is the execution face shared by the environment-setup, zone-ops and data-management work modes: the ADC job workflow (template -> task -> Argo log) for training, QC and labeling jobs, data files, collect plans, mining and multimodal retrieval, host and TKE evidence collection, cloud resource queries, and image build/push to the zone registry. Covers call order, the write gate (two-phase confirmation; show the summary to the user, then send back the exact confirm_text, idempotent), what the guardrails reject, and how to read a failed job. Use when a task needs this connector capability inside the ADC zone. Boundary: this skill only explains tool usage, it performs no actions itself.
